title: Executable reasoning repairs programs and earns exact authority

observed_failures: Planning and calibration produced three syntax-invalid programs each because every independent strategy had only one generation attempt.
Three differently written programs implemented the same wrong upper-median interpretation and were incorrectly treated as independent semantic authority.
The resource-control validator rejected truthful refused or failed sandbox attempts even though the producer correctly charged them.
Long structured outputs reached the shared 320-token ceiling.

verification.static_integrity: Ruff, Python compilation, and git diff hygiene passed

claim_boundary: This checkpoint repairs campaign-observed producer, metering, and admission defects. It proves one reusable ordered-selection family from public instructions and prevents unproven consensus from regressing the baseline. It does not establish a general reasoning gain, frontier performance, fusion authority, activation authority, or WOW Signal.
remaining: Replace the shared 320-token ceiling with task-aware, treatment-control-identical generation budgets and continuation-safe completion.
Diagnose and repair zero accepted latent optimization steps and absent fast-weight use.
Run a bounded 1.5B calibration before another immutable resident-32B four-arm campaign.
